description: C1 (decisions C1-10, C1-11): act two's main thread. It starts once act two has begun (act.two.begun: after the act-one finale, or at once without cutscenes; for a save that finished act one in an older build, on its first Continue in the world) and leads the tracker from then on. Hear the oath-holders at the Stone Throne (the rim council: each act-one settlement's pledge), climb the Breach north of the Cairnlands (a stage-6 size gate; XP floored at level 13), grow to stage 7 at the Rimstone, prove the colossus's strength to Last Hearth (quest.rim_colossus; XP floored at level 15), grow to stage 8 at the Rimstone, and look out from the Hoarwatch toward the Hoarcrown - where milestone D's Frostbound Titan will come down. XP: council 100, breach 200, grow7 300, trials 200, grow8 300, hoarwatch 150.

stages.objective: Hear the oath-holders at the Stone Throne
stages.waiting_text: The oath-holders gather by the Stone Throne with word of the rim and of what their people will do.

stages.objective: Climb the Breach north of the Cairnlands
stages.waiting_text: The Rim Road runs north from the Cairnlands to the Breach. Only a giant of the old height can climb it.

stages.objective: Grow to stage 7 at the Rimstone
stages.waiting_text: The Rimstone stands on its rise past the Fallen King, along the Kings' Causeway.

stages.objective: Prove the colossus's strength to Last Hearth
stages.waiting_text: Maera keeps Last Hearth, the hold-outs' camp under the rim west of the Breach's top.

stages.objective: Grow to stage 8 at the Rimstone
Look out from the Hoarwatch toward the Hoarcrown
